title: GRPO-$λ$: Credit Assignment improves LLM Reasoning

rs.key_step: 先将GAE梯度重排成TD residual乘历史logprob trace；再以group normalized return近似TD残差。
rs.why_non_obvious: 精确重排不意味着无critic的残差替代也是精确GAE；trace把信号传给过去token。
rs.trigger_condition: When no critic is available, reuse a trace representation of policy gradients and approximate residuals from grouped outcomes.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When no critic is available, reuse a trace representation of policy gradients and approximate residuals from grouped outcomes.

signatures.information: 终局验证reward、旧/新token logprob、group mean/std
signatures.failure_boundary: negative clamp/trace改变优化，数学任务外未验证；Table1与Figure1最优配置结果不同。

relevance.how: sequence reward通过trace给历史token耦合权重，非动作因果necessity。
仍使用group mean/std，额外trace不消除scale不变性。
